question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM pizza_clean_runner_orders
    WHERE cancellation IS NULL OR cancellation = ''
),
pizza_items AS (
    SELECT 
        c.order_id,
        c.pizza_id,
        CAST(trim(split_part(pr.toppings, ',', n)) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders c
    INNER JOIN delivered_orders d ON c.order_id = d.order_id
    INNER JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON c.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
    INNER JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(1, 20)) AS g(n) ON TRUE
    WHERE n <= array_length(string_split(pr.toppings, ','), 1)
    AND trim(split_part(pr.toppings, ',', n)) != ''
),
extra_items AS (
    SELECT 
        e.extras AS topping_id,
        e.extras_count
    FROM pizza_get_extras e
    INNER JOIN delivered_orders d ON e.order_id = d.order_id
)
SELECT 
    pt.topping_name,
    CAST(
        (
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pizza_items pi WHERE pi.topping_id = pt.topping_id) +
            COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ei.extras_count) FROM extra_items ei WHERE ei.topping_id = pt.topping_id), 0)
        ) AS INTEGER
    ) AS total_quantity
FROM pizza_toppings pt
ORDER BY pt.topping_name
